reasons: Section 10.5 selects New York law, matching the preferred governing-law position, and the deterministic check confirms the jurisdiction is within the accepted set.
No arbitration clause or foreign/vendor-home venue exists elsewhere in the agreement, so there is no walk-away or fallback failure on a material term.

The only gap — no express exclusive-jurisdiction reference to state and federal courts in New York County — is a missing sub-mechanic that the playbook directs be noted in the rationale rather than redlined; the rationale does exactly that.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is unchanged from the original text and no counterparty comment is proposed.
